newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen facing mild profit-taking at open.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen facing mild profit-taking at open.

text.p: The Dow industrials are likely to face some mild profit-taking early in the session on Monday sharp run-up on Friday but analysts are far from calling an end to the latest rally in blue chips.
"In the absence of any major economic news today, I would not be a bit surprised to see some profit-taking early in the session," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained more than 53 points on Friday and will open at an all-time high of 6471.76.
